next_action.rationale: Traces from a failed authorization request by one of the 214 affected users will show exactly what entitlements the app evaluated in its 403 check. This directly discriminates between: (a) app is reading old pre-sync entitlements (supports C03/stale_authz_cache), (b) app received entitlements in unexpected format or version (supports role_sync_error), or (c) app is missing the new roles entirely (supports role_sync_error). This is the single highest-information diagnostic available.
next_action.expected_information_gain: Seeing the entitlement payload in the authorization trace will either confirm the app has stale data (matching old pre-02:10 roles) or reveal a version/format mismatch. If the trace shows the new roles but the app still denies, it points to logic error. If trace shows old roles, it confirms C03 and moves stale_authz_cache from hypothesis to inference.
